text:
marta: Heads-up — a customer on Dedicated hit us with a SEV: their SIEM BigQuery sink is missing tenant_id and request_id on ~10% of rows since 2025-11-02 03:00 UTC. They say alerts didn't fire.
samir: Oof. Any job ids / manifests? Is this the new parquet exporter or the legacy newline-json sink?
marta: parquet exporter. Job id from their manifest: export_job_20251102_03_17. Attached sample row they shared (redacted):
```
{ "timestamp": "2025-11-02T03:12:04Z", "event": "policy.evaluated", "tenant": null, "request_id": null, "user": "acct-123" }
```
audit-forwarder-bot: export_job_20251102_03_17 finished with warnings: [WARN_SCHEMA_MISMATCH, WARN_PARTITION_EMPTY, WARN_DECRYPTION_PARTIAL]
cloudops: I see KMS decrypt errors in the exporter logs around 03:12 — folded entries with error "DECRYPTION_FAILED: key alias mismatch". Could be rotation + old alias still referenced in job metadata.
lydia: If the exporter fails decrypt for certain files, we sometimes emit placeholder records with stripped PII and missing tenant fields until replay completes. But that should set a flag in manifest. Does manifest show partial_decrypt=true?
marta: Customer's manifest lines: 
```
{"file":"gs://redwood-exports/prod/2025-11-02/03/export_job_20251102_03_17/part-0001.parquet","size":0,"partial_decrypt":true}
{"file":"gs://redwood-exports/prod/2025-11-02/03/export_job_20251102_03_17/part-0002.parquet","size":124812}
```
samir: size=0 for part-0001 explains missing rows, but why was a zero-byte object uploaded? That usually happens when export worker aborts after acquiring write lock. Need the worker logs for that timeframe.
jeff: Also watch for schema drift: new optional field "meta.tenant_hint" was introduced in model 2025-10 deploy; our schema normalization step maps tenant->tenant_id if present but if decrypt failed we drop nested object entirely.
marta: Repro steps I ran on staging:
1) Force KMS alias rotation in staging: `gcloud kms keys versions destroy --key export-key --version 3` (simulate) 
2) Trigger exporter against small window: `curl -X POST https://exporter.internal/run?job=export_job_test&window=2025-11-02T03:00/2025-11-02T03:15`
3) Observe manifest items and check `gsutil ls -l` for zero-byte files
Result: one file created with size 0 and manifest flagged partial_decrypt.
samir: Good repro. Short-term remediation: (a) replay missing window for that tenant (we can re-run export_job_20251102_03_17 with force_replay=true), (b) patch exporter to mark rows with original payload redacted instead of emitting null tenant/request_id so SIEM can correlate by other fields.
cloudops: Also we should rotate KMS alias back or ensure exporter uses newest alias mapping. I'll open infra ticket to check alias mapping service cache TTL — suspect stale mapping.
lydia: For longer term: add a schema fallback that preserves request_id in top-level even if nested decrypt fails (we can copy top-level request_id from GCS object metadata if present). Also add a validation job that runs after export and posts a compact delta to the manifest (missing_rows > 0 => create replay ticket).
marta: Customer is asking for ETA and repro steps for compliance audit. Proposed reply:
- immediate: we've queued a targeted replay of 2025-11-02 03:00–03:20 for their tenant (ETA 45m). We will deliver a signed manifest and a validation diff.
- root cause: partial KMS decrypt during exporter run caused zero-byte placeholders + schema-normalizer to drop nested tenant/request_id fields.
- mitigations: hotfix to exporter to mark redacted rows, clear alias cache, add post-export validation + auto-replay for >0 missing rows.
jeff: Add one more note: check retention policy on sink dataset — if retention TTL removed older partitions early, replay might not find original raw files. Confirmed dataset ttl = 90d so OK for this window.
marta: I'll run the replay and update the customer. tagging @cloudops and @samir to follow up on alias cache and exporter patch. :thumbsup:
samir: I'll chase the logs and open a PR for the redaction marker. Will also add a unit test for zero-byte manifest handling.
cloudops: I'll create an infra incident to sweep KMS alias propagation and add alerts for decrypt error rate > 0.5% per export run.
audit-forwarder-bot: ticket exported: RED-EXPORT-1991 (replay), RED-INFRA-724 (kms alias cache), RED-ENG-1027 (exporter redaction flag)
marta: thanks — will paste customer note once replay completes.
